ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/grey) pixels across the visible right lobe surface; left lobe is predominantly low-intensity due to shadowing and angle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe: Large contiguous white region in the center-right; dense black mottling clusters along the leading and inner edges; distinct dark cluster at the distal tip. Left lobe: Mapping is partially obscured by water spray and lower exposure.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture angle of 55 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys (3-12 pixels in depth) along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a strong convex sweep terminating in a sharp, pointed distal tip; left lobe sweep is partially submerged.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels diameter) scattered across the high-intensity white region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to five distinct, near-vertical dark linear streaks visible on the lower proximal region of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Trailing edge shows extreme irregularity and fraying, suggestive of extensive historical tissue loss; vertical rake marks are present on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe distal tip is unusually pointed and elongated compared to typical fluke morphology.
